scope: Reviewed deviations of data/weapons.json from the source values scripts/frosty-weapons.py reads. Key: weapon and field (leaf path as the checker prints it; dmg is the whole curve as [range, damage] pairs). sourceValue is the computed value the row was reviewed against, siteValue the committed value (null = absent). The checker reports each row applied, STALE (the source or the site moved), REDUNDANT (they now agree) or UNUSED; the last three fail --check. Kinds: convention (a site modelling rule), observed (in-game result kept over the file), emulated-bug, pending-check (site looks wrong or unreadable by the files; needs a decision), precision (site stores fewer digits than the source: site wrong under the full-precision rule, not yet changed).

overrides.reason: The site models the DB-12 as a two-round burst per pump (dual tube): rpm and burstRpm are RateOfFireForSingleFire 359.999, burstRounds 2, and burstBurstsPerMinute = 60 / (BoltActionTime / BoltActionSpeed + BoltActionDelay + 2 x 60 / RateOfFireForSingleFire) = 60 / (0.433334 + 0.033334 + 2 x 60 / 359.999) = 74.99978819480148 (reproduced exactly with shortest-decimal operands). The WB stores primary mode 1 (bolt/pump), no alternates and Shot burst rounds 3, so the files give the pump cycle rpm 94.737 and no burst fields. A Dual Shot part (WPM_ERG_DualShot_W25, bullets-per-shot field Field_ebd2880e 2) is in 2.1.2.0 but in no equipment list (checklist U7); the site convention predates it.
overrides.evidence: docs/STALE_SITE_DATA.md "DB-12 fire rate"; RUN/S9/A/summary.txt; DP12_WB FireLogic (Field_16e6fa59 1, Field_9b956c3d [], BoltAction Field_a1abbce8 0.433334 / Field_caf2ace0 0.033334, Field_be31b12d 359.999), 2.1.1.0 and 2.1.2.0
